_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. a reference sheet of paper objects laid flat: a waxed produce box stamped ALICE'S WHOLESALE BAIT & SMOKED MEATS; a butcher-paper note in blocky grease pencil taped with electrical tape; a postcard back covered edge to edge in tiny cramped handwritten capitals; a bus schedule with every departure circled in pencil; a crab derby flyer with a large meticulously hatched crab; a small stapled quarter-letter zine; a hand-lettered corner box advertisement in a squared display face; a yellowed newspaper page with a tide table beside a comic strip. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
